name: NilocG Thrive All-in-One
description: Comprehensive macro+micro all-in-one for high-tech tanks. Manufacturer-disclosed per-dose figures: 1 pump (2 ml) per 10 US gal (~37.85 L) adds ~6 ppm NO3, ~1.1 ppm PO4, ~5 ppm K, and ~0.25 ppm Fe.
notes: Targets the EI nutrient window with one bottle. 'Thrive+' and 'Thrive C' variants use different per-dose ratios — this entry is the original Thrive.
